sections.title: Overview
sections.html:
• Reference date: 2026-10-26 (KST) · issue id 2026-10-26-event · mode event (incremental) · previous issue 2026-10-23-event (3rd issue) · previous monthly issue 2026-10 (source: workflow-injected issue info · state.run)
  • Reason: The measurement layer detected that the checkpoint of trigger T5 ("$40 billion financing confirmation condition (8-K)") arrived on 2026-10-26 and fired (source: data/spacex_watch.json due list, 2026-10-26)
  • Reference price: $147.49 — close on Friday 2026-10-23. At the time of writing (KST morning), the US market had not opened on 10/26 (stockanalysis daily history, viewed 2026-10-26: latest row 10/23). +1.9% versus the previous issue's reference price of $144.75 (10/22) (formula: 147.49 ÷ 144.75 − 1)
  • Scope: Only what T5 touches — Axis D (financials), milestone D-2027-1, rule R3 and proposed new rule ②, trigger T5. T4 (Amazon Leo) is not a reason for this issue and its checkpoint remains 12/01. No full PHASE 1–4 recalculation is performed (source: state.triggers_next_12m · prompts/monthly_run.md).
Conclusion first: There is still no 8-K. As of 2026-10-26, SpaceX's latest EDGAR filings are the 10/22 S-8 and 10-Q, and the last 8-K was the 10/20 earnings filing. Instead, the CEO stated in an X post on 10/25 (US time) that the "$40 billion GPU debt has closed," and Bloomberg (10/23) reported that this financing is an off-balance-sheet structure through an SPV. Management statements are not a basis for determination, so T5 is unconfirmed, and milestones, probabilities and fair value are unchanged. Three things changed — ① off-balance-sheet vehicles were included in the 'additional financing' definition ② proposed new rule ③ (Bear +5 if the off-balance-sheet vehicle is recognized as consolidated debt) was registered ③ the T5 verification path was widened from the single 8-K to three: 8-K, 10-K notes, and IR (source: Section 1 table below · Section 2 · Section 3 table).

종결 여부"다음 주 가격 확정"CEO 는 "종결", 보도는 "투자자가 최종 조건에 합의했는지·완전 종결됐는지 불명확" — Goldman·Apollo 논평 거부⑤ Bloomingbit(Bloomberg 10/25 전재) · investinglive 10/26
만기·콜·전환·증자 요소미보도만기·콜 조건·전환/증자 요소 전부 미공시·미보도(CEO '콜러블'은 발언)—

판정: T5 는 미확정. 공시(①)도 회사 공식 자료(②)도 없고, 1급 보도(⑤)는 "종결 여부 불명확"이라고 쓴다. 이정표 D-2027-1("2027 추가 조달 $500억 이하 AND 증자 없음")은 판정 연도 미도래 + 원문 없음으로 미판정 유지. 규칙 신설 제안 ②(금리 8% 초과 확정 시 약세 +5)는 심의 보류 유지 — 보도 8.3%·'8%대 중반'은 심의 대상이 아니다 (출처: state.rule_proposals_not_applied · prompts/monthly_run.md 1항).

8-K 가 언제까지 나와야 하는가(추정): 8-K Item 2.03 은 직접 금융채무 또는 중요한 부외 약정 발생 후 4영업일 안에 낸다. CEO 게시가 10/25(일)이므로 체결일이 10/23(금)이면 10/29(목), 10/26(월)이면 10/30(금)이 기한이다. 그래서 확인점을 10/31 로 둔다. 다만 SPV 가 SpaceX 의 직접·우발 채무를 만들지 않는 구조라면 Item 2.03 대상이 아닐 수 있다 — 그 경우 조건은 10-K 의 부외 약정·리스 주석에서야 보인다(추정, Item 2.03 규정 기준). 이것이 이번 회차가 T5 의 확인 경로를 넓힌 이유다.

sections.title: 2 The Question the Off-Balance-Sheet Structure Raises for Milestone Definitions — Definition Fixed
sections.html:
The 'additional financing' in D-2027-1 has so far considered only debt and equity raises in the company's own name. Now that an SPV off-balance-sheet structure has been reported, the definition must be fixed first so the next issue can make a determination (Protocol item 2: if a definition is ambiguous, fix the definition first and record it in state). The definition fixed in this issue (source: state.definitions.additional_financing, 2026-10-26):

  • Additional financing = ① debt the company borrowed or issued directly + ② amounts raised by off-balance-sheet vehicles for which the company bears payment obligations such as lease payments, purchase commitments, or guarantees. Counted by economic substance, regardless of accounting consolidation.
  • Equity raise = issuance of dilutive securities such as common stock, convertible bonds, and convertible preferred stock. Includes structures where SPV equity is exchanged or converted into company shares.
  • Rationale: The meaning of the milestone is 'dependence on external funding and dilution.' If the company repays debt in exchange for GPU use, it is the same even if the SPV is the named party. A precedent is already in the filings — the three Valor equipment leases were designed as sale-and-leasebacks but, after audit, were recognized as 'failed sale-and-leasebacks' and booked as consolidated debt of $12,897M (10-Q R65, 2026-10-22; Bloomberg's republication states the same fact as "about $13 billion in debt recognized").
  • Determination not yet made: Whether the reported SPV falls under this definition will be judged only from the text of an 8-K or 10-K (source: state.definitions.additional_financing.not_applied_yet).

Proposed new rule ③ (not applied): "If the off-balance-sheet vehicle for the $40 billion GPU financing is confirmed as recognized as consolidated debt in the 10-K (fiscal 2026) or a later 10-Q → Bear +5%p." Reason: if the off-balance-sheet design collapses, the premises for debt/EBITDA and credit rating change. Not reflected in this issue's numbers (source: state.rule_proposals_not_applied).
